title: The Last Bus from the Market
story: After a morning at the town market, Yusuf had two heavy bags. The last bus home left from a stop behind the fish stalls. He looked at the main road and could not see a sign. A seller named Pilar pointed to a narrow lane. Yusuf thanked her and walked quickly with both bags. The bus was already at the stop, and the doors were open. He showed his pass, climbed on, and found a seat near the driver. A passenger held one bag while he sat down. Yusuf sent a text to his father to say he had caught the bus. At his stop he lifted both bags and nodded to the passenger. The bags were heavy, but he was glad he had asked for help. That evening he drew a small map of the lane for his next visit. He pinned the map inside the kitchen cupboard.
